text:
maria: Quick thread for relnotes QA before we cut the docs release. Items: cache-v2 migration note, route-policies beta blurb, and a couple of snippet fixes. Need copy + a short known-issue line about transient 503s on Dedicated and one about localized screenshot mismatches.
ben: I can do the bullets. Keep them 1 line each for the release page and a slightly longer paragraph for the full relnotes.
oliver: Snippet-lint flagged two JS examples and one Go sample. I'll open tiny PRs to fix. The JS change is `client.options.batch.mode` -> `client.batch({ mode: 'adaptive' })`.
maria: Please don't paste the full snippets in the relnotes — include a 1-line example and link to the SDK ref.
tim: Running docs CI on the relnotes branch now. Heads up: docs-ci will fail if the localized anchors are broken; l10n team already pinged.
docs-ci: automated: build started for branch docs/relnotes-3712349999; running linkcheck + snippet-lint.
l10n-bot: automated: Detected missing anchors: /fr/guides/cache#migration and /de/guides/routing#beta. Raised #1458.
oliver: PRs opened: #1459 (js snips), #1460 (go snips). Kept diffs tiny: `client.batch({ mode: 'adaptive' })` and in Go `client, _ := NewClientWithOpts(ctx, opts)`.
ben: Draft bullets for release page: - Cache v2: faster warmups, lower memory; one-line migration available. - Route policies (beta): prefer cost or region with safe fallbacks. - SDK snippet refresh: small API changes in JS/Go/Python. Known issues: - Some Dedicated clusters may briefly return 503s during GPU warmup; retry after ~20s. - A small set of localized screenshots may show outdated UI copy; translations and images will be updated in the next patch.
maria: Nice. For the relnotes body please add a Migration section with this tiny diff inline: ```diff
- client.cache_mode = "legacy"
+ client.set_cache_mode("v2")
``` Keep it fenced and short.
oliver: I added that diff to content/guides/cache-v2-migration.md in PR #1461. Also updated the snippet link targets.
tim: docs-ci: linkcheck failed due to the two missing anchors flagged by l10n-bot; snippet-lint also reported an unused import in go/snippets/example_test.go.
oliver: Fixing go import now in #1462. For anchors, should we add redirects or update the anchors upstream?
l10n-bot: automated: suggest adding temporary redirect entries for the missing anchors to avoid blocking release. See #1458 for details.
maria: Plan: oliver lands snippet fixes and the tiny import cleanup, tim will add redirects for the two anchors, ben will finalize relnotes copy, I will merge once docs-ci passes. Aim to cut release 2 hours from now.
ben: Homepage blurb option: "Try Cache v2 (faster warmups) and Route Policies (beta)  see release notes." Keep short.
tim: Added redirects in #1463 for the two anchors. Re-running docs-ci.
docs-ci: automated: build passed after link redirects; snippet-lint cleared; staging deploy created (build 1234).
maria: Perfect. Merging relnotes now and will monitor post-publish for any localization fallout. If any customer issues surface, open an incidents thread and tag me.
